property_summary: For any callee that reverts when sent value, the reference contract's sendMoney call always reverts (does not return successfully) while the mutated contract may return successfully (silently ignoring failure); the test asserts that calling sendMoney against a reverting helper never returns ok (true) on the correct contract — a mutant that drops the require will make the call succeed (ok == true) for some fuzzed value.
change_summary: Change the low-level call to ignore the returned success (remove the require), so failures do not revert and sendMoney may silently fail to transfer funds to _target.
